title: Saved pallet layout
description: How one master carton is stacked on a pallet, level by level. One document per carton ID, stored by the saving helper as system/http-listener/system/generated/pallet_layouts/<CARTON_ID>.json. All lengths are millimetres. The origin (0, 0) is one corner of the pallet; x runs along the pallet length, y along the pallet width. Every level is one carton height tall, so level k sits at z = k * carton.height_mm above the pallet deck.

schema.description: Document type marker, written by the helper.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Bump it (and teach the page and the helper the new shape) when a field changes meaning.

carton_id.description: Master carton ID exactly as it appears in the tool. The key: saving again for the same ID (compared without regard to upper/lower case) replaces the document.

carton.description: Outside size of the carton the layout was built for. The tool only applies a saved layout while the carton still has this size (within 0.6 mm); otherwise it falls back to the suggested layout and says so.

pallet.description: Deck size of the pallet the layout was built on.

ship_method.description: Shipment method the stack height was limited for.

max_height_mm.description: Stack height limit that applied (cartons only, pallet deck excluded): 1600 for air, 2200 for truck. level_count * carton.height_mm never exceeds it.

overhang_mm.description: How far, per side, cartons were allowed to hang over the pallet edge when the layout was built (the Settings tab's overhang allowance at that time). 0 or absent means every carton lies inside the deck. With an allowance, x and y may go down to -overhang_mm and a carton may end up to overhang_mm beyond the deck.

level_count.description: Number of levels. Derived, written by the helper.

carton_count.description: Total cartons on the pallet. Derived, written by the helper.

origin.description: Where the layout started: built by hand from an empty pallet, or taken from the tool's suggested layout (and possibly edited).

source_fg_id.description: FG the layout was opened from in FG Lookup, when there was one. Informational only.

saved_at.description: UTC time of the save, written by the helper.

saved_by.description: Windows user name of whoever saved it, written by the helper.

levels.description: Levels from the bottom up: levels[0] rests on the pallet. Empty levels are not stored.

items.description: The cartons on one level. They must not overlap each other and must lie inside the pallet.

box.description: One carton seen from above. x, y is the corner nearest the pallet origin; l is its extent along the pallet length and w along the pallet width. l x w is either carton.length_mm x carton.width_mm or the same turned 90 degrees.

x.description: 0 or more, or down to -overhang_mm when the layout allows overhang.

y.description: 0 or more, or down to -overhang_mm when the layout allows overhang.
